Community-vetted access

Clear before you confirm

Interest mode, rates, fees, limits, repayment terms and digital contract details are shown before the request is completed.

Interest Confirmation & Loan Access

Know who is lending — and which product is available to you.

Before you request, ReferredBy gives you a dedicated Interest Confirmation view. It explains the lending relationship and the pricing structure that applies to the specific borrower and product.

Who is involved in your loan?

Your screen can identify the Referring Partner, Lending Society and Participating Lender connected to your account. It also shows the active interest mode, applicable fees and loan limits.

Nano Loan

Shorter-term access

When Nano Loans are enabled on your profile, the app shows the amount range and terms that apply to your current level.

  • Eligibility shown in-app
  • Profile-level limits
  • Terms shown before confirmation
  • Statement and repayment tracking

Availability is subject to your current account status and applicable product rules.

Term Loan

Structured instalment lending

Eligible users can access Term Loan requests based on account level, instalment maximum and the requirements of the participating lending setup.

  • Term instalment maximum visible
  • Loan period and repayment schedule
  • Interest and fees disclosed in-app
  • Document and eligibility checks

A disabled product button means that product is not currently available to the account.

Review, confirm, track and build your history.

Review before you sign

There is no single amount that applies to everyone. Your Profile and Request Loan screens show the limits currently available to your account, subject to your level, status and product rules.

A product may be unavailable because of your current account status, active or outstanding facilities, document/KYC requirements, account level or other product eligibility rules.

Your Interest Confirmation screen shows the active interest mode and values that apply to your account, together with the lender setup, fees and relevant limits.

Open Statement from your Profile to view loan details and repayment dates. Credit Score History shows your current rating, score breakdown and rating events.
